introHtml: Zippered office supplies keep your branded materials secure and organized during travel or daily commutes. Whether you need custom zippered portfolios for client meetings or padded organizers for sales teams, the zipper closure prevents papers and accessories from spilling out. Choose from nylon, polyester, or vegan leather options with full-color imprint areas. These practical giveaways show attention to detail while keeping your logo visible every time the case is opened.
